title: CBHF 0.1.0 handoff questions
description: Schema for handoff/questions.json. related_conflict_ids / related_unknown_ids are string id references (e.g. cfl_*, unk_*). Cross-file existence checks are Validator-stage.

priority.description: Priority label as used in packages. No closed enum is defined in CBHF 0.1.0 docs (example uses high); do not invent an enum here.

related_conflict_ids.description: References to conflict_id values in uncertainty/conflicts.json.

related_unknown_ids.description: References to unknown_id values in uncertainty/unknowns.json.
